state.note: No audio or transcript is available. Judge from structure only.

will_book.instructions: This state is a structural trace of an AI receptionist call that schedules appointments (clinic or service provider). There is no transcript. Will this call end with a booked appointment written to the scheduling system?

criteria.true: A slot will be confirmed and created before the call ends.
criteria.false: The caller will leave without a booked appointment.

failure_mode.instructions: What is the dominant failure or success mode visible in the structure?

criteria.clean_book: Lookup, offer and booking all succeeded with little friction.
criteria.recovered_error: An earlier tool, identity or booking failure was later overcome and the call booked.
criteria.identity_block: Patient lookup or verification never succeeded.
criteria.no_availability: Slot search or booking kept failing and the call stalled there.
criteria.info_only: The caller only gathered information and never tried to book.
criteria.declined_offer: The caller was offered a booking or slot and turned it down.
criteria.caller_drop: Long silence, refusal, or hangup ended the call.
criteria.agent_loop: Repeated stages or tools without forward progress.

agent_progress.instructions: How far did the agent advance the scheduling workflow?
criteria: Never got past greeting or identity
Reached intent or search but made no real offer
Offered a provider or slot but did not book

needs_human.instructions: Should a human receptionist have taken over, based on structure alone?

criteria.true: Stuck identity, refusal or silence, or repeated tool failure.
criteria.false: The agent was still making workflow progress.

visible_error_overweight.instructions: Does the trace contain an early visible error that a competent agent often recovers from (a failed lookup then retry, one failed booking then another slot)?

legend.0: Never got past greeting or identity
legend.1: Reached intent or search but made no real offer
legend.2: Offered a provider or slot but did not book
